issues: Backup does not include receipt photos: src/lib/backup.ts only serialises receipts and mileage entries, omitting any attached photo files, violating the requirement that encrypted backup files contain all records *and* photos.

Export CSV may not correctly handle commas or special characters in all fields: src/lib/exportCsv.ts (not shown) should ensure proper quoting/escaping of all CSV fields to prevent malformed files and injection, beyond just prefixing a single quote for formula injection.

Export throttling is missing: src/lib/exportCsv.ts and src/lib/exportPdf.ts can be invoked repeatedly without disabling the Export buttons or rate‑limiting, allowing denial‑of‑service attacks as identified in the security checklist.

Record count limits are not enforced: there is no cap on the number of receipt or mileage entries, enabling potential resource exhaustion on the device (see src/lib/storage/store.ts and related store wrappers).

Temporary backup files are not deleted on the native side after sharing: src/lib/files.ts deletes the temporary file only after sharing succeeds, but if Sharing.isAvailableAsync() returns false the temporary file remains, violating the cleanup requirement.
feedback: While all acceptance tests pass, several critical functional and security requirements from the original spec are incomplete or missing. Implement photo inclusion in backups, ensure robust CSV quoting, add export throttling, enforce reasonable record caps, and guarantee cleanup of temporary backup files regardless of sharing availability. Address these gaps before the solution can be approved.
